guidance.ok: Resting heart rate is within the expected range.
guidance.warning: Resting heart rate is outside the expected range. Rest and recheck; seek medical advice if it persists.
guidance.critical: Resting heart rate is far outside the expected range. Seek medical support immediately.

guidance.ok: Systolic blood pressure is within the expected range.
guidance.warning: Systolic blood pressure is outside the expected range. Rest and recheck soon.
guidance.critical: Systolic blood pressure is dangerously outside the expected range. Seek medical support immediately.

guidance.ok: Diastolic blood pressure is within the expected range.
guidance.warning: Diastolic blood pressure is outside the expected range. Rest and recheck soon.
guidance.critical: Diastolic blood pressure is dangerously outside the expected range. Seek medical support immediately.

guidance.ok: Blood oxygen saturation is within the expected range.
guidance.warning: Blood oxygen saturation is below the expected range. Sit still, breathe normally and recheck.
guidance.critical: Blood oxygen saturation is critically low. Seek medical support immediately.

guidance.ok: Body temperature is within the expected range.
guidance.warning: Body temperature is outside the expected range. Monitor and recheck.
guidance.critical: Body temperature is dangerously outside the expected range. Seek medical support immediately.

guidance.ok: Sleep duration is within the recommended range.
guidance.warning: Sleep duration is outside the recommended range. Aim for consistent rest.
